description: Unique identifier for the WikiPathways pathway [bioregistry:wikipathways]
Name or label of the pathway
List of ancestor pathways in the ontology (always empty: WikiPathways has no pathway hierarchy)
List of descendant pathways in the ontology (always empty: WikiPathways has no pathway hierarchy)
Direct child pathways of the current pathway (always empty: WikiPathways has no pathway hierarchy)
Direct parent pathways of the current pathway (always empty: WikiPathways has no pathway hierarchy)
Hierarchical path of the pathway; for WikiPathways this is the pathway alone, as it has no hierarchy
